items.title: File the Cuyahoga County lodging tax return
items.authority: Cuyahoga County Fiscal Office, Lodging Occupancy Tax Office
items.description: The county tax is 6.5% of gross short-term rent, including non-optional fees. Register and get approved first, then file monthly online through the county's GovOS portal by the 21st of the month after the period; a form is required even for months with no rentals. Late: 10% penalty plus 3% monthly interest. Phone 216-443-7140.

items.title: File the Montgomery County lodging tax return
items.authority: Montgomery County Office of Management and Budget
items.description: The 3% tax applies to hotels and motels with five or more sleeping rooms. Returns are filed electronically on the county website by the last day of the month after the stay (February stays due March 31); register for an account number first. Late filing or payment brings interest, fines and penalties.

items.title: File the Summit County lodging tax return
items.authority: Summit County Fiscal Office, Lodging Excise Tax Department
items.description: The tax is 5.5%. Lodging establishments mail each month's return with payment to the Lodging Excise Tax Department in Akron; the page read does not state the day of the month. The lodging registration form is due by January 31 each year. Phone 330-643-2437.
